data.one_liner: NLTK-port to perform stemming in Dart and Flutter and reduce words to their base form.
data.what_it_does: The stemmer package provides algorithms like PorterStemmer and SnowballStemmer ported from Python's NLTK library. It reduces words to their base or root form, supporting case-sensitive or default lowercase outputs.
use_when: You need to implement search indexing or natural language processing in Dart.
You want to reduce English or supported language words to their root forms.
avoid_when: You need advanced linguistic lemmatization based on dictionary lookups rather than algorithmic stemming.
strengths: Implements standard Porter and Snowball stemming algorithms.
Ported directly from the well-tested Python NLTK library.
weaknesses: Stemming can produce non-dictionary base words (e.g. 'agreed' to 'agre').
Limited to the algorithms ported from NLTK.
